function.name: sealagom_search_warnings
function.description: Search the world's navigational warnings (NAVAREA and coastal). Returns count and warnings with text, positions and, on paid plans, the analysis (headline, severity, status, validity, keep-clear distance). The warning text is the authority.

country.description: Country name, partial match, for coastal warnings

ai_category.description: military, cables, offshore, sar, piracy_or_security, drifting_object, wreck, aids_to_navigation, ice, survey, other

ai_in_force.description: Only warnings in force right now

topic.description: A feed: ice, military, cables, offshore...

function.name: sealagom_warnings_near
function.description: Warnings in force within a radius of a position, with distance and bearing to the nearest point.

function.name: sealagom_route_check
function.description: Check a voyage: the NAVAREAs crossed in order and every warning within the corridor, with distance along the route and whether it is in force at the ETA of that point.

function.name: sealagom_navareas
function.description: The 21 NAVAREAs with coordinator, the region id to use as navarea_id, and warnings in force.

function.name: sealagom_feeds
function.description: Every themed feed (military, cables, offshore, rigs, ice...) with its endpoint and how many of its warnings are in force.

function.name: sealagom_find_port
function.description: Ports by name, UN/LOCODE or country, or the nearest to a position. Rows have slug (use it with sealagom_port_details), name, country, position, harbour size, NAVAREA.

function.name: sealagom_port_details
function.description: One port: time zone, tide range, depths, max draft, harbour type, shelter, approach and pilotage, VTS and VHF, anchorages, restrictions, facilities, warnings near it, shared routes.

function.name: sealagom_stations_near
function.description: Rescue coordination centres covering a position and DSC coast stations in range (NGA Pub 117): MMSI, bands, watch times, telephone, e-mail.

function.name: sealagom_find_vessel
function.description: A vessel by name, call sign or MMSI: every warning naming it, the vessel rows (name, MMSI, call sign), coast stations with that MMSI, the last AIS report when the live feed is on.

function.name: sealagom_convert_route
function.description: Write waypoints as a route file: rtz (ECDIS), gpx, kml (Google Earth, My Maps), csv or nmea. Returns the file text.

function.name: sealagom_rigs
function.description: Mobile offshore drilling units with their last reported positions.
